verses.en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.pt: Quando acabou de proferir todas estas palavras aos ouvidos do povo, entrou em Cafarnaum.
verses.en_web: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
verses.en_bbe: After he had come to the end of all his words in the hearing of the people, he went into Capernaum.

verses.en: And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
verses.pt: E um servo de certo centurião, de quem era muito estimado, estava doente, quase à morte.
verses.en_web: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
verses.en_bbe: And a certain captain had a servant who was very dear to him; this servant was ill and near to death.

verses.en: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
verses.pt: O centurião, pois, ouvindo falar de Jesus, enviou-lhes uns anciãos dos judeus, a pedir-lhe que viesse curar o seu servo.
verses.en_web: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
verses.en_bbe: And when news of Jesus came to his ears, he sent to him rulers of the Jews, requesting that he would come and make his servant well.

verses.en: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
verses.pt: E chegando eles junto de Jesus, rogavam-lhe com instância, dizendo: É digno de que lhe concedas isto;
verses.en_web: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
verses.en_bbe: And they, when they came to Jesus, made their request warmly, saying,

verses.en: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
verses.pt: porque ama à nossa nação, e ele mesmo nos edificou a sinagoga.
verses.en_web: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
verses.en_bbe: It is right for you to do this for him, because he is a friend to our nation, and himself has put up a Synagogue for us.

verses.en: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
verses.pt: Ia, pois, Jesus com eles; mas, quando já estava perto da casa, enviou o centurião uns amigos a dizer-lhe: Senhor, não te incomodes; porque não sou digno de que entres debaixo do meu telhado;
verses.en_web: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus went with them. And when he was not far from the house, the man sent friends to him, saying, Lord, do not give yourself trouble: for I am not important enough for you to come into my house:

verses.en: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.pt: por isso nem ainda me julguei digno de ir à tua presença; dize, porém, uma palavra, e seja o meu servo curado.
verses.en_web: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
verses.en_bbe: And I had the feeling that I was not even good enough to come to you: but say the word only, and my servant will be well.

verses.en: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.pt: Pois também eu sou homem sujeito à autoridade, e tenho soldados às minhas ordens; e digo a este: Vai, e ele vai; e a outro: Vem, e ele vem; e ao meu servo: Faze isto, e ele o faz.
verses.en_web: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
verses.en_bbe: For I, myself, am a man under authority, having men under me; and I say to this one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.

verses.en: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.pt: Jesus, ouvindo isso, admirou-se dele e, voltando-se para a multidão que o seguia, disse: Eu vos afirmo que nem mesmo em Israel encontrei tamanha fé.
verses.en_web: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: And when these things were said to Jesus, he was surprised, and, turning to the mass of people coming after him, said, I have not seen such great faith, no, not in Israel.

verses.en: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
verses.pt: E voltando para casa os que haviam sido enviados, encontraram o servo com saúde.
verses.en_web: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.
verses.en_bbe: And when those who were sent came back to the house they saw that the servant was well.

verses.en: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
verses.pt: Pouco depois seguiu ele viagem para uma cidade chamada Naim; e iam com ele seus discípulos e uma grande multidão.
verses.en_web: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about, after a little time, that he went to a town named Nain; and his disciples went with him, and a great number of people.

verses.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
verses.pt: Quando chegou perto da porta da cidade, eis que levavam para fora um defunto, filho único de sua mãe, que era viúva; e com ela ia uma grande multidão da cidade.
verses.en_web: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.
verses.en_bbe: Now when he came near the door of the town, a dead man was being taken out, the only son of his mother, who was a widow: and a great number of people from the town were with her.

verses.en: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
verses.pt: Logo que o Senhor a viu, encheu-se de compaixão por ela, e disse-lhe: Não chores.
verses.en_web: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the Lord saw her, he had pity on her and said to her, Be not sad.

verses.en: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
verses.pt: Então, chegando-se, tocou no esquife e, quando pararam os que o levavam, disse: Moço, a ti te digo: Levanta-te.
verses.en_web: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
verses.en_bbe: And he came near, and put his hand on the stretcher where the dead man was: and those who were moving it came to a stop. And he said, Young man, I say to you, Get up.

verses.en: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
verses.pt: O que estivera morto sentou-se e começou a falar. Então Jesus o entregou à sua mãe.
verses.en_web: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
verses.en_bbe: And the dead man got up, and words came from his lips. And he gave him to his mother.

verses.en: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
verses.pt: O medo se apoderou de todos, e glorificavam a Deus, dizendo: Um grande profeta se levantou entre nós; e: Deus visitou o seu povo.
verses.en_web: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”
verses.en_bbe: And fear came on all, and they gave praise to God, saying, A great prophet is among us: and, God has given thought to his people.

verses.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
verses.pt: E correu a notícia disto por toda a Judéia e por toda a região circunvizinha.
verses.en_web: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea, and in all the surrounding region.
verses.en_bbe: And this story about him went through all Judaea and the places round about.

verses.en: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
verses.pt: Ora, os discípulos de João anunciaram-lhe todas estas coisas.
verses.en_web: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
verses.en_bbe: And the disciples of John gave him an account of all these things.

verses.en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.pt: E João, chamando a dois deles, enviou-os ao Senhor para perguntar-lhe: És tu aquele que havia de vir, ou havemos de esperar outro?
verses.en_web: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
verses.en_bbe: Then John sent two of his disciples to the Lord, saying, Are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?

verses.en: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
verses.pt: Quando aqueles homens chegaram junto dele, disseram: João, o Batista, enviou-nos a perguntar-te: És tu aquele que havia de vir, ou havemos de esperar outro?
verses.en_web: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”
verses.en_bbe: And when the men came to him they said, John the Baptist has sent us to you, saying, Are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?

verses.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
verses.pt: Naquela mesma hora, curou a muitos de doenças, de moléstias e de espíritos malignos; e deu vista a muitos cegos.
verses.en_web: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.
verses.en_bbe: At that time, he made a number of people free from their diseases and their pains, and from evil spirits; and to others who were blind he gave back the use of their eyes.

verses.en: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
verses.pt: Então lhes respondeu: Ide, e contai a João o que tens visto e ouvido: os cegos vêem, os coxos andam, os leprosos são purificados, e os surdos ouvem; os mortos são ressuscitados, e aos pobres é anunciado o evangelho.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
verses.en_bbe: And answering them he said, Go back and give news to John of what you have seen, and the things which have come to your ears; the blind now see, those who had no power in their legs are walking, lepers are made clean, those who had no hearing now have their ears open, dead men come to life again, and the poor have the good news given to them.

verses.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
verses.pt: E bem-aventurado aquele que não se escandalizar de mim.
verses.en_web: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
verses.en_bbe: And a blessing will be on him who has no doubts about me.

verses.en: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
verses.pt: E, tendo-se retirado os mensageiros de João, Jesus começou a dizer às multidões a respeito de João: Que saístes a ver no deserto? um caniço agitado pelo vento?
verses.en_web: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
verses.en_bbe: And when the men who were sent by John had gone away, he said to the people, about John, What did you go out into the waste land to see? a tall stem moving in the wind?

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings courts.
verses.pt: Mas que saístes a ver? um homem trajado de vestes luxuosas? Eis que aqueles que trajam roupas preciosas, e vivem em delícias, estão nos paços reais.
verses.en_web: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
verses.en_bbe: But what did you go out to see? a man in soft clothing? See now, those who have beautiful clothing and delicate food are in kings' houses.

verses.en: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.pt: Mas que saístes a ver? um profeta? Sim, vos digo, e muito mais do que profeta.
verses.en_web: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
verses.en_bbe: But what did you go out to see? a prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.

verses.en: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
verses.pt: Este é aquele de quem está escrito: Eis aí envio ante a tua face o meu mensageiro, que há de preparar adiante de ti o teu caminho.
verses.en_web: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
verses.en_bbe: This is he of whom it has been said, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way before you.

verses.en: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
verses.pt: Pois eu vos digo que, entre os nascidos de mulher, não há nenhum maior do que João; mas aquele que é o menor no re medida com é maior do que ele.
verses.en_web: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, Among all the sons of women, not one is greater than John: but he who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

verses.en: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
verses.pt: E todo o povo que o ouviu, e até os publicanos, reconheceram a justiça de Deus, recebendo o batismo de João.
verses.en_web: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
verses.en_bbe: (And all the people, and the tax-farmers, to whom John had given baptism, when they had knowledge of these things, gave glory to God.

verses.en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
verses.pt: Mas os fariseus e os doutores da lei rejeitaram o conselho de Deus quando a si mesmos, não sendo batizados por ele.
verses.en_web: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
verses.en_bbe: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were against the purpose of God for themselves, not having had his baptism.)

verses.en: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
verses.pt: A que, pois, compararei os homens desta geração, e a que são semelhantes?
verses.en_web: “To what then will I liken the people of this generation? What are they like?
verses.en_bbe: What comparison am I to make of the men of this generation? what are they like?

verses.en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
verses.pt: São semelhantes aos meninos que, sentados nas praças, gritam uns para os outros: Tocamo-vos flauta, e não dançastes; cantamos lamentações, e não chorastes.
verses.en_web: They are like children who sit in the marketplace, and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
verses.en_bbe: They are like children who are seated in the market-place, crying out to one another, and saying, We made music for you, but you did not take part in the dance; we gave cries of sorrow, but you were not sad.

verses.en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
verses.pt: Porquanto veio João, o Batista, não comendo pão nem bebendo vinho, e dizeis: Tem demônio;
verses.en_web: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
verses.en_bbe: For John the Baptist came, taking no food or drink, and you say, He has an evil spirit.

verses.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
verses.pt: veio o Filho do homem, comendo e bebendo, e dizeis: Eis aí um comilão e bebedor de vinho, amigo de publicanos e pecadores.
verses.en_web: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
verses.en_bbe: The Son of man came feasting, and you say, Here is a lover of food and wine, a friend of tax-farmers and sinners.

verses.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
verses.pt: Mas a sabedoria é justificada por todos os seus filhos.
verses.en_web: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”
verses.en_bbe: But wisdom is judged to be right by all her children.

verses.en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
verses.pt: Um dos fariseus convidou-o para comer com ele; e entrando em casa do fariseu, reclinou-se à mesa.
verses.en_web: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house, and sat at the table.
verses.en_bbe: And one of the Pharisees made a request that he would take a meal with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house and took his seat at the table.

verses.en: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
verses.pt: E eis que uma mulher pecadora que havia na cidade, quando soube que ele estava à mesa em casa do fariseu, trouxe um vaso de alabastro com bálsamo;
verses.en_web: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
verses.en_bbe: And there was a woman in the town who was a sinner; and when she had news that he was a guest in the Pharisee's house, she took a bottle of perfume,

verses.en: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.pt: e estando por detrás, aos seus pés, chorando, começou a regar-lhe os pés com lágrimas e os enxugava com os cabelos da sua cabeça; e beijava-lhe os pés e ungia-os com o bálsamo.
verses.en_web: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
verses.en_bbe: And went in and took her place at the back of him, near his feet, weeping, so that his feet were washed with the drops from her eyes, and with her hair she made them dry, and kissing his feet she put the perfume on them.

verses.en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
verses.pt: Mas, ao ver isso, o fariseu que o convidara falava consigo, dizendo: Se este homem fosse profeta, saberia quem e de que qualidade é essa mulher que o toca, pois é uma pecadora.
verses.en_web: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”
verses.en_bbe: Now when the Pharisee in whose house he was saw it, he said to himself, This man, if he was a prophet, would be conscious what sort of woman this is who has put her hands on him, that she is a sinner.

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
verses.pt: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhe: Simão, tenho uma coisa a dizer-te. Respondeu ele: Dize-a, Mestre.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, answering, said, Simon, I have something to say to you. And he said, Master, say on.

verses.en: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
verses.pt: Certo credor tinha dois devedores; um lhe devia quinhentos denários, e outro cinquenta.
verses.en_web: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Two men were in debt to a certain man of business: one had a debt of five hundred pence, and the other of fifty.

verses.en: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
verses.pt: Não tendo eles com que pagar, perdoou a ambos. Qual deles, pois, o amará mais?
verses.en_web: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
verses.en_bbe: When they were unable to make payment, he made the two of them free of their debts. Which of them, now, will have the greater love for him?

verses.en: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
verses.pt: Respondeu Simão: Suponho que é aquele a quem mais perdoou. Replicou-lhe Jesus: Julgaste bem.
verses.en_web: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
verses.en_bbe: Simon, in answer, said, It seems he whose debt was greater. And he said, Your decision is right.

verses.en: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
verses.pt: E, voltando-se para a mulher, disse a Simão: Vês tu esta mulher? Entrei em tua casa, e não me deste água para os pés; mas esta com suas lágrimas os regou e com seus cabelos os enxugou.
verses.en_web: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.
verses.en_bbe: And turning to the woman he said to Simon, You see this woman? I came into your house; you did not give me water for my feet: but she has been washing my feet with the drops from her eyes, and drying them with her hair.

verses.en: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.pt: Não me deste ósculo; ela, porém, desde que entrei, não tem cessado de beijar-me os pés.
verses.en_web: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
verses.en_bbe: You did not give me a kiss: but she, from the time when I came in, has gone on kissing my feet.

verses.en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.pt: Não me ungiste a cabeça com óleo; mas esta com bálsamo ungiu-me os pés.
verses.en_web: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
verses.en_bbe: You put no oil on my head: but she has put perfume on my feet.

verses.en: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
verses.pt: Por isso te digo: Perdoados lhe são os pecados, que são muitos; porque ela muito amou; mas aquele a quem pouco se perdoa, pouco ama.
verses.en_web: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.”
verses.en_bbe: And so I say to you, She will have forgiveness for her sins which are great in number, because of her great love: but he who has small need of forgiveness gives little love.

verses.en: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
verses.pt: E disse a ela: Perdoados são os teus pecados.
verses.en_web: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to her, You have forgiveness for your sins.

verses.en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
verses.pt: Mas os que estavam com ele à mesa começaram a dizer entre si: Quem é este que até perdoa pecados?
verses.en_web: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
verses.en_bbe: And those who were seated at table with him said to themselves, Who is this who even gives forgiveness of sins?

verses.en: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
verses.pt: Jesus, porém, disse à mulher: A tua fé te salvou; vai-te em paz.
verses.en_web: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to the woman, By your faith you have salvation; go in peace.
